OdmTransformExport.title: Export for Medidata Rave
OdmTransformExport.description: Exports the {count} form(s) of the current preview as ODM XML that Medidata Rave can import. Everything that can be fixed automatically is fixed; the rest is listed for manual review.
OdmTransformExport.study_oid_hint: Optional. Rave uses the Study OID to match the target project.
OdmTransformExport.protocol_name_hint: Optional. Rave's project name. Defaults to the exported protocol name, truncated to 50 characters.
OdmTransformExport.manual_review: {count} issue(s) could not be fixed automatically. Resolve them in OpenStudyBuilder, or in Rave after the import.
